Aider CUT à apprendre : les réglages du: Help CUT learn: the edit’s settings are sent on export, never the sound, the images or the text
À chaque export d’une vidéo, ONIRIQUE CU: Each time a video is exported, ONIRIQUE CUT sends Onirique’s server the settings of the edit (style, length of the excerpt, frame, transitions, fonts, colors and sizes of the text, effects) and the type of your account (founder or not). Never the sound, the images, the text (lyrics, movie line, title, description) or the file names, and nothing that links these settings to your account or to your IP address. On the basis of our legitimate interest in improving CUT, they are used to evolve the settings it suggests (its “tree”, where every change is approved by a founder); those of the videos already kept in the CUT cloud were taken in once the same way. They are kept for three years at most. To stop sending anything, untick “Help CUT learn” in CUT’s Publish step.
